objective: EvoPilot v1.0 readiness through two real projects, each with two real delivery rounds, forward and reverse workflows, Codex use, upgrade and recovery verification, and an explicit final user release decision

targets.scope: Current roadmap, readiness contract and acceptance checklist
First real project reverse onboarding, two real asset deliveries, version consistency and recovery
Second real project with two real rounds, preferably forward requirement/design workflow
Exact v1.0 candidate combination regression, readiness report and user release decision

acceptance.requirement: Formal installed plugin first use succeeds in the current chat
Correct immutable release baseline and traceable analysis coverage
Ontology and Harness meet native v1 syntax and semantics and required questions are closed
Two real asset delivery rounds with substantive input and complete version relationships
Actual inputs, Runs, references, evaluations and retained receipts agree
evidence: raw report to structured input mapping
execution and quality results reported separately

acceptance.requirement: Source differences and affected asset update process demonstrated
Mandatory Codex use and recovery checks pass
evidence: upgrade regression when a product upgrade occurs

acceptance.requirement: Original project, releases and private data boundaries preserved
Usage, maintenance, issues, Target state and closure evidence synchronized

loops.intent: Bind source and authorized paths; record plan and governance
Installed plugin first use and private project/Goal
Release-source reverse analysis and source coverage
First native assets, semantic review and immutable private delivery
Real evidence, pinned Runtime evaluation and receipts
Real second-round change, impact, delivery and regression
Recovery, exact versions, maintenance and closure

completionRule: All mandatory items require actual candidate-bound evidence; missing, unknown, skipped and unexecuted never mean PASS. T2/T3 remain incomplete until separately executed.
boundaries: Preserve historical v0.1 governance and frozen specifications
All project assets and evidence stay in verified private workspace scope
Original project is read-only; checks use isolated copies without production databases or release pipelines
Service state changes use public owner APIs
No automatic source synchronization is claimed
New product defects require separately bound repair targets; no inherited release authority
Synthetic tests do not count as real business evidence
Technical results never invent business confirmation or release approval
progressPolicy: Real-project selections, authorization, status and evidence are private workspace campaign records. This file defines generic product criteria only.
